PAGE NAME: Report bed bugs in your apartment
PAGE TYPE: Transaction
PRIMARY USER: Tenant

DESCRIPTION: Report a bed bug problem so we can inspect your home.

WHAT TO KNOW:
- Bed bugs spread quickly in shared housing.
- We inspect for signs of infestation.

WHAT TO DO:
- Call 311 to file a complaint.
- Keep records of bites and sightings.

SYSTEM RELATIONSHIPS:
Parent: Healthy housing and pests (Topic)
